name: Roasted Carrots and Parsnips
description: A simple roasted vegetable dish featuring carrots, parsnips, and onions with a maple syrup and mustard glaze.
recipeIngredient: 1 lb parsnips, peeled and cut into 1-inch pieces
1 lb carrots, peeled and cut into 1-inch pieces

recipeInstructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Place parsnips, carrots, onions, oil, and thyme in a prepared baking dish; toss until vegetables are well coated with oil.
Roast in the oven for 30 minutes.
In a small bowl, combine maple syrup and mustard.
Pour the maple syrup mixture over the vegetables and toss to coat.
Roast for another 20 to 25 minutes or until vegetables are tender and golden, stirring once.

keywords: roasted carrots, roasted parsnips, maple syrup glaze

_similar.name: Creamy Chicken Stew
_similar.description: A hearty and comforting chicken stew with vegetables in a creamy sauce.
recipeIngredient: 3 lb boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut into 1-inch cubes

recipeInstructions.text: Heat oil in a Dutch oven. Sprinkle chicken with salt, pepper, and paprika. Cook and stir until the chicken is browned. Drain.
Add raw vegetables, basil, bay leaf, celery salt, and 5 cups broth; bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer for 30 minutes or until vegetables are tender.
Remove bay leaf. Add canned vegetables. Cook and stir for 2 minutes.
In a saucepan, mix flour and butter or margarine until smooth. Gradually whisk in remaining 2 cups broth. Bring to a boil. Cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened.
Pour the sauce into the Dutch oven. Stir and bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Simmer, uncovered, for 5 minutes.
Serve hot with rolls or biscuits.

_similar.keywords: chicken stew, creamy stew, comfort food

_similar.name: Barley and Corn Casserole
_similar.description: A hearty barley casserole with corn, carrots, and garlic, perfect as a comforting side dish.

recipeInstructions.text: Heat oil in a heavy casserole. Cook onion, garlic, and carrots until the onion is softened, stirring frequently.
Stir in barley and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Pour in vegetable stock, cover, and bake at 350 °F for 1 hour.
Test that barley is tender. Stir in corn and parsley.
Return to the oven to heat through. Season with pepper to taste.

_similar.keywords: barley casserole, corn, carrots, comforting side dish

_similar.name: Maple Glazed Ribs
_similar.description: A sweet and savory pork spare ribs recipe glazed with a maple syrup-based sauce.

recipeInstructions.text: Cut ribs into serving-size pieces and place in a roasting pan. Cover and bake for 1½ hours or until tender.

Meanwhile, combine the Dijon mustard, maple syrup, Worcestershire sauce, orange juice, curry powder, garlic, ketchup, green onions, and soya sauce in a saucepan. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Drain the ribs and pour the sauce over them. Bake uncovered for an additional ½ hour, stirring occasionally.

_similar.keywords: maple glazed ribs, pork spare ribs, sweet and savory

_similar.name: Stir-Fry Beef
_similar.description: A quick and flavorful beef stir-fry with vegetables and a savory sauce, served over cooked rice.
recipeIngredient: 2 lb boneless beef sirloin, cut into pieces
1 large green pepper, cut into strips

recipeInstructions.text: Heat vegetable oil in a frying pan.
Add beef and stir-fry until cooked through. Set aside.
Add peppers and onion to the pan and stir-fry until tender.
Stir in the mixture of tomato soup, soya sauce, orange juice, and vinegar. Cook until heated through.
Return beef to the pan and heat through, stirring occasionally.
Serve the beef mixture over cooked rice.

_similar.name: Creamy Beef and Potato Bake
_similar.description: A layered casserole featuring ground beef, potatoes, zucchini, and a creamy cheddar sauce.
recipeIngredient: ½ cup prepared tomato pasta sauce

recipeInstructions.text: Preheat oven to 350°F to 375°F.
In a skillet, melt 2 tablespoons butter and oil over medium-low heat. Add potatoes and cook for 5 minutes, stirring frequently.
Add zucchini, salt, and pepper to the skillet. Cook until zucchini is tender.
Spoon the vegetable mixture into a 13x9 inch baking dish. Set aside.
In the same skillet, cook onion and Italian seasoning until onion is tender.
Add ground beef to the skillet and cook until it loses its pink color. Stir in tomato sauce and ½ cup milk.
Spoon the meat mixture over the vegetable layer in the baking dish.
Melt remaining butter in the skillet, stir in flour, and cook for 1 minute.
Gradually whisk in remaining milk. Cook and stir until the sauce thickens.
Stir in cheddar cheese until melted. Pour the sauce over the meat layer.
Bake at 350°F for 20 to 25 minutes.
Let stand for 10 minutes before serving.

_similar.keywords: beef casserole, potato bake, creamy sauce
